text: 《通知》协同推进科技金融领域数据开发利用，发布《全国科技金融领域数据开发利用目录1.0》，涵盖企业名单与科创属性、进出口、投融资、经营、研发投入、知识产权、创新能力评价、企业需求等8大类、26个数据指标。支持各地形成具有区域特色的科技金融数据开发利用清单，建设省级科技金融领域数据开发利用配套信息设施，加强现有信息系统资源互联互通，促进数据信息归集共享。坚持统筹发展与安全，规范科技公共数据开发利用，加强全过程安全管理，切实防范各种数据风险。
text_en: The Notice promotes coordinated data development and utilization in sci-tech finance, releasing the 'National Sci-Tech Finance Data Development and Utilization Directory 1.0,' covering 8 categories and 26 data indicators, including enterprise lists, sci-tech attributes, imports/exports, investments and financing, operations, R&D spending, IP, innovation capability ratings, and enterprise needs. It supports regions in creating tailored sci-tech finance data development lists, building supporting information facilities, enhancing interconnectivity of existing systems, and promoting data collection and sharing. It emphasizes balancing development and security, standardizing sci-tech public data use, strengthening full-process security management, and preventing data risks.
